senses.gloss: इशीका A pupil in the elephantʼs eye.

इषि(षी)का [इष् गत्यादौ क्वुन् अत इत्वम्]
—1 Reed, rush, stalk of grass; कुशकाशशरेषिकाः Rām.; Kaṭh. 2. 6. 17.
 ˚अस्त्रम् R. 12. 23.
—2 An arrow.
—3 A sort of sugar-cane; Saccharum Spontaneum.
—4 A small stick of wood or iron used to see whether gold in a crucible
 is melted or not.
—5 A brush.
—6 The eye-ball of an elephant.
—7 A thorny plant; संनिकर्षादिषीकाभिर्मोचितः परमाद्भयात् Rām. 2. 8. 30.
.━{@Comp.@}: इषिकातूलम्

इषि(षी)का [इष् गत्यादौ क्वुन् अत इत्वम्]
—1 Reed, rush, stalk of grass; कुशकाशशरेषिकाः Rām.; Kaṭh. 2. 6. 17.
 ˚अस्त्रम् R. 12. 23.
—2 An arrow.
—3 A sort of sugar-cane; Saccharum Spontaneum.
—4 A small stick of wood or iron used to see whether gold in a crucible
 is melted or not.
—5 A brush.
—6 The eye-ball of an elephant.
—7 A thorny plant; संनिकर्षादिषीकाभिर्मोचितः परमाद्भयात् Rām. 2. 8. 30.
.━{@Comp.@}: इषिकातूलम्

—1 An elephantʼs eye-ball. Edgerton, the author of Mātaṅga L., however,
 says that this meaning is wrong and points out that it means, ‘The under surface of the top of the eye-socket of an elephant. ईषिका त्वक्षिकूटकम्’
 Mātaṅga L. 6. 9.
—2 A painterʼs brush.
—3 A weapon, arrow, dart.
—4 A kind of missile.

—1 A painterʼs brush.
—2 An ingot-mould.
—3 = इषीका q. v.

इषित p. p. (fr. इष् €4 cl.)
—1 Moved, driven, sent, despatched.
—2 Excited, animated.
—3 Quick, speedy.

ईशिता, -त्वम्
 Superiority, greatness, one of the eight Siddhis or
 attributes of Śiva. See अणिमन्.

इषिर a. Ved. [इष्-गतौ-किरच्]
—1 Juicy, succulent, refreshing, fresh.
—2 Powerful, strong, quick, active. —3 Moving.
इषिर + .{@-रम्@} ind. Quickly. स्वधामिषिरां पर्यपश्यन् Rv. 10. 157. 5.

ईशितृ a. [ईश्-तृच्] An owner, a master, proprietor. ━m.
 The lord of the Universe; न चेशिता नैव च तस्य लिङ्गम् Śvet. Up. 6. 9.
 अव्यक्तोऽभूदीशितेव प्रणादः Śi. 18. 3.

ईशितव्य a. To be reigned or ruled over; ईशितव्यैः किमस्माभिरीशस्यैतद्विडम्बनम्
 Bhāg. 10. 23. 45.

ईशिता, -त्वम्
 Superiority, greatness, one of the eight Siddhis or
 attributes of Śiva. See अणिमन्.

ईशिन् a. [ईश्-णिनि] Commanding, reigning &c. ━m.
—1 A god.
—2 A husband.
—3 A lord, master.
ईशिन् + .{@-नी@} Supremacy; ईशत ईशिनीभिः Śvet. Up. 3. 1.
